issues.detail: The Hebrew 'כִּכַּר' (kikkar) means 'talent' (a unit of weight), not '餅' (cake/loaf). The Chinese renders '三百塊餅銀子' and '三十塊餅金子' as 'three hundred cakes of silver' and 'thirty cakes of gold', which is a mistranslation of the unit of measure. It should be '三百他連得銀子' (three hundred talents of silver) and '三十他連得金子' (thirty talents of gold).
